policy.production: DeepSeek director, creator and independent reviewer; all max; no external candidate content edits
policy.versions: Freeze each workflow profile and implementation before first call; changed profiles use new run ids
policy.evaluation: One fixed rubric across all rounds; retain failures and all token/time costs
policy.comparison: Different topics and single samples cannot establish a causal score improvement; repeat a development case after a material change
policy.holdout: Run only after development assessments and final profile are frozen; never tune on its result and still call it held out
policy.stopping: Aim for three production/evaluation rounds, add same-topic regression when needed; do not force changes just to reach an iteration count
policy.success: No critical learning/technical blocker, consistent quality on development and held-out content; still needs listening and target-student validation
policy.guardrails: No fixed storyboard, scene count, character, palette or requirement for constant motion

brief.audience: 已接触速度与重力的高中学生
brief.goal: 解释同高度水平抛出、忽略空气阻力时，横向初速度改变射程但不改变落地时间，并能预测改变高度后的结果。

facts.model: 质点、均匀重力场、无空气阻力、初始竖直速度为零；比较横速时初始高度相同
facts.coordinates: x=vx*t, y=h-g*t*t/2, ground y=0, y axis upwards

brief.guidance: 原创表达，独立选择例子、叙事与画面，不接受旧片、旧讲稿、分镜或逐片修改意见。
review_standards: 科学与画面一致，条件清楚
因果有画面或推导依据，不只宣告结论
观众可辨认关键过程与前后对应
字幕与动作不产生意义矛盾
视觉清楚且精简，完整连续

brief.audience: 知道频数和简单概率的高中学生
brief.goal: 解释条件概率为什么需要改变被计数的集合，并区分P(A|B)与P(B|A)，让观众能预测改变群体构成后的条件概率。

facts.meaning: Restrict the sample population to B; count A within it
facts.example_optional: 100 cards: 60 red (45 round), 40 blue (5 round). P(red|round)=45/50=0.9; P(round|red)=45/60=0.75
facts.boundary: The counting model assumes uniform sampling from the stated population; changing its composition changes the probability

brief.guidance: 例子和视觉表示由作者自主选择；不照搬物理运动的节奏或分镜。
review_standards: 分子分母和被筛选集合正确对应
能看见条件如何改变样本集合
区别正向和反向条件而非背诵公式
字幕可读，画面有明确主次

brief.audience: 知道欧姆定律的高中学生
brief.goal: 解释理想恒压电源下，两条并联支路中一条电阻改变，为什么另一支路电流不变而总电流改变，并能预测新参数下的结果。

facts.model: Ideal constant-voltage source, negligible wire resistance, purely resistive steady-state parallel branches
facts.voltage: Both branches share the source voltage U
facts.optional_example: U=12V, R1=6ohm, R2=12ohm: I1=2A, I2=1A, total=3A. Changing R2 to6ohm gives I2=2A, I1 remains2A, total=4A
facts.boundary: A nonideal source or significant shared wire resistance can change branch voltage, so the unchanged-current claim then needs rechecking

brief.guidance: 独立选择表达方式，不要求角色、流动粒子或慢动作；图示方向与电路连接应一致，不把电流描述为被电阻消耗。
review_standards: 解释不变电压如何决定不变支路电流
区分支路变化和总量变化
预测有依据且条件清楚
视觉、字幕和讲解一致可读
